Tor Adib ♡
Amar priyo Afrin, 💗

Ajker din ta amar kache onek special, karon ei dinei amar favourite manush ta ei prithibite eshechhilo. Tor 18 bochorer journey-r notun chapter shuru holo, ar ami mon theke chai ei chapter ta hashite, shanti-te ar bhalobashay bhore uthuk.

Tui amar life-e ashar por theke chhoto chhoto moment-o onek special hoye geche. Tor hashita amar kharap din-o bhalo kore dey. Tor sathe kotha bola, tor sathe time spend kora, ar tor oi cute expression gulo amar kache onek precious. Shob shomoy feelings perfect vabe express korte pari na, kintu toke niye amar feelings ekdom real. 🩷

Ami chai tui shob shomoy nijer moto kore glow kor, nijer shopno gulo puron kor, ar kokhono nijeke chhoto kore dekhish na. Mon kharap hole mone rakhish, ekjon ache je tor smile dekhte chai, tor kotha mon diye shunte chai, ar tor pashe thakte chai. Tor happiness amar kache khub important.

Happy 18th Birthday, amar jaan! Allah tor jibon khushi, shanti, success ar oshonkho shundor moment-e bhoriye dik. Tor prottekta wish ekdin shotti hok. Ar amader golpo ta jeno aro onek birthday, onek hasi, ar onek bhalobasha niye egote thake. 🌷

Ajke mon khule hashish, nijeke pamper kor, ar mone rakhish tui onek loved. Words diye shob bojhano jay na, kintu ami chai amar kaj diye protidin toke feel korate je tui amar kache koto special.

I love you, Afrin. ♡
Forever yours, Adib

eighteen looks lovely on you

18 little reasons I adore you

I could list a million, but here are eighteen tiny reminders for your eighteenth birthday. 🩷

01.Tor shundor hashita, ja amar mood instantly bhalo kore dey.
02.Tor chokher oi mishti expression gulo.
03.Tui jokhon nijer moto kore golpo koris.
04.Tor caring nature, ar chhoto chhoto detail mone rakha.
05.Tor sathe thakle everything ektu easy lage.
06.Tui jokhon mon khule hashish, puro vibe tai change hoye jay.
07.Tor cute ragiye jawa, tarpor abar normal hoye jawa.
08.Tui amar kotha shunish, even jokhon ami random kotha boli.
09.Tor nijer ekta alada, shundor personality ache.
10.Tui amar ordinary din gulokeo memorable kore dish.
11.Tor chhoto chhoto happiness share korar style ta.
12.Tui jokhon nijer shopno niye excited hoye porish.
13.Tor sathe silence-o awkward lage na.
14.Tui amar kache just special na, genuinely precious.
15.Tor bhalobasha dekhano chhoto chhoto ways.
16.Tui ja, shei bhabei enough. Toke change hote hobe na.
17.Tor sathe aro onek memory create korar excitement.
18.Shob kichhur age tui Afrin, ar toke bhalobashata amar kache shobcheye special. ♡
warning: may cause unexpected butterflies
